Moment S5 built-in Fuji-style LUT source review
Review date: 2026-10-13

Decision
--------
No reviewed collection satisfied all of: an existing suitable SDR sRGB/Rec.709
cube set, clearly authorized redistribution, and no Fujifilm official LUT data.
The task's fallback was used: original procedural artistic approximations.
No source code, numeric recipe data, LUT nodes, images or profiles from the
repositories below were copied or incorporated into the generator or assets.
This review is bounded to the repositories listed; it does not claim that no
suitable collection could exist elsewhere.

Bundled source (all eight files)
-------------------------------
Source repository: https://github.com/USER-HFC/moment-s5
Source file: tools/generate_fuji_style_luts.py
Author: USER-HFC and Moment S5 contributors
License: MIT, full text in third_party/fuji-style-LICENSE.txt and APK assets
Pinning: luts/manifest.json contains the generator SHA-256 and each cube SHA-256;
the task completion report records the local generation commit after committing.
Assets: fuji-style-provia-standard.cube, fuji-style-velvia.cube,
fuji-style-astia.cube, fuji-style-classic-chrome.cube,
fuji-style-classic-negative.cube, fuji-style-eterna.cube,
fuji-style-acros.cube, fuji-style-pro-neg-standard.cube.

Reviewed, rejected or not adopted (not bundled)
---------------------------------------------

1. YahiaAngelo/Film-Luts
   Source: https://github.com/YahiaAngelo/Film-Luts
   Commit: af957b631a304e6be94778b96cb3395de3438e9f
   Repository author: Yahia Angelo (YahiaAngelo); underlying LUT authors varied.
   Declared repository license: MIT.
   Evidence: README.md, sections Disclaimer and License; LICENSE.
   Reason: the README disclaims ownership of the LUTs and warns they may have
   other owners' copyrights. The repository-wide MIT statement does not establish
   a clear per-asset redistribution chain for its G'MIC/XTrans collection.
   Pinned README:
   https://github.com/YahiaAngelo/Film-Luts/blob/af957b631a304e6be94778b96cb3395de3438e9f/README.md

2. pyrocat101/Fujifilm-LUTs
   Source: https://github.com/pyrocat101/Fujifilm-LUTs
   Commit: c687686384bbe6983c7d20d5ade21068d08dfbf8
   Repository author: pyrocat101.
   License: no repository license file found in this commit's recursive tree.
   Evidence: README.md opening paragraphs and generated output paths.
   Reason: explicitly generated from Fujifilm's official F-Log2C/F-Gamut C LUTs;
   excluded by the task regardless of possible technical resampling/conversion.
   Pinned README:
   https://github.com/pyrocat101/Fujifilm-LUTs/blob/c687686384bbe6983c7d20d5ade21068d08dfbf8/README.md

3. hulk-2019/FujiSim
   Source: https://github.com/hulk-2019/FujiSim
   Commit: 665c9844cbe58faa222d41d070ec0ba7f239a71e
   Repository author: hulk-2019.
   License: no repository license file found in this commit's recursive tree.
   Evidence: GitHub repository metadata, recursive tree and README.md.
   Reason: a parametric simulation application, no checked-in .cube set and no
   clear license grant at the reviewed commit; not adopted.

4. sadziu/Fuji-Recipe-Converter
   Source: https://github.com/sadziu/Fuji-Recipe-Converter
   Commit: a6691ea0e880ddd5fd19d7ca2d48a502fb0e7e07
   Repository author: sadziu.
   License: MIT for repository code, third-party tools retain their own licenses.
   Evidence: LICENSE, README.md and recursive tree (zero .cube assets).
   Reason: this is a recipe conversion/generation tool, not an existing cube set.
   It honestly calls its outputs approximations. We chose a small independently
   authored standard-library generator and did not reuse its implementation.

5. cedeber/hald-clut (also used by alexanderawerin/PhotoChrome)
   Source: https://github.com/cedeber/hald-clut
   Commit: 3b3180f82d4dcea1e6e8c5648473539a910d7f49
   Repository author: cedeber; source LUT/profile authors varied.
   Declared repository license: GPL-3.0.
   Evidence: LICENSE, repository tree (HaldCLUT PNGs, no .cube set), and
   https://github.com/alexanderawerin/PhotoChrome README License/Sources.
   Reason: not the clearly permissive independently authored cube set sought for
   this MIT app; its camera-profile-derived asset provenance would need further
   review. No GPL code, CLUTs or profiles were incorporated.

Method and limits
-----------------
GitHub repositories/README/license files were inspected, with full commit hashes
from the GitHub API and recursive trees checked for .cube and licensing files.
GitHub search and public web search were used for discovery. No physical camera
was available, so these original looks are neither camera-calibrated nor
validated as matching Fujifilm's proprietary simulations. A LUT is a static
RGB transform and cannot emulate camera grain, sharpening or other spatial or
exposure-adaptive behavior. Presets operate on display-encoded SDR RGB values;
they are not log/RAW/HDR transforms or a colorimetric sRGB-to-Rec.709 conversion.
